silboProducts.title: SILBO Networking Products
silboProducts.subtitle: Industrial networking hardware for mission-critical industrial and telecom environments.
silboProducts.intro: SILBO is Invendis's dedicated industrial networking brand — delivering rugged routers, gateways, protocol converters, and switches purpose-built for Industry 4.0 connectivity challenges.

items.name: Multi-WAN Router
items.description: 4G/5G, Wi-Fi 4/5/6, and dual-SIM with load balancing and VPN support for secure industrial connectivity.

items.name: Industrial Gateway
items.description: Edge computing gateways for data aggregation, local processing, and cloud connectivity at industrial sites.

items.name: Protocol Converter
items.description: Modbus, DNP3, IEC, and SNMP protocol bridging for legacy equipment integration and industrial automation.

items.name: Network Switch
items.description: Industrial managed and unmanaged Ethernet switches rated for -40°C to +75°C operating environments.

items.name: SD-WAN Gateway
items.description: Software-defined WAN gateways with centralised policy control and secure site-to-site tunnelling.

items.name: Cloud NMS
items.description: Centralised, cloud-hosted network management for provisioning, monitoring, and firmware updates.

items.name: 4G Dongle
items.description: Plug-and-play 4G/5G USB dongles for rapid failover connectivity at remote sites.

items.name: Controllers
items.description: Configurable I/O controllers for automation, remote switching, and site-level process control.

softwarePlatforms.title: Software Agnostic Platforms
softwarePlatforms.subtitle: Cloud-based and on-premise platforms for monitoring, analytics, and operations management.

items.name: PizGloria RMS Platform
items.description: Cloud-based Remote Monitoring System with graphical site views, executive dashboards, energy analytics, and Power BI integration. Deployed for telecom and solar customers globally.

items.name: Workforce Management Software
items.description: Centralized workforce management system for connected operations, providing workforce tracking, resource allocation, productivity monitoring, and real-time operational visibility.

items.name: Mobile App
items.description: Field operations mobile application for real-time alarm acknowledgment, site visits, trouble ticketing, and manager-level executive views — iOS and Android.

items.name: Utility Billing Platform
items.description: End-to-end energy utility billing solution with meter data management, tariff configuration, invoice generation, and customer portal.

items.name: Alarm & Notification Engine
items.description: Automated escalation matrix delivering SMS, email, and push notifications based on configurable alarm thresholds and SLA windows.

items.name: Analytics & Reporting
items.description: Backend analytics layer with customised algorithms for predictive maintenance, energy anomaly detection, and executive KPI reporting via Power BI.

items.name: NMS – Network Management
items.description: Centralised network management system for SILBO devices, providing configuration management, performance monitoring, and fault management.
